In this video we cover:
New Electricity Payment Rules Explained
We’ll explore how India is changing electricity billing with new rules that link prices to time, solar supply, and usage patterns. Power will be cheaper during the day and costlier during peak hours, pushing consumers to shift consumption.
At the same time, large users may face charges on net metering and could be required to install batteries, reducing their reliance on the grid. These changes aim to fix inefficiencies, manage solar surplus, and make the power system more sustainable.
